17 buses are running from Vijayawada covering all residential areas like Patamata, Labbipeta, Moghalraj Puram, Chuutugunta, Krishna Lanka, One Town, Ramavarappadu, Gunadala, Machavaram, Seetharam Puram, Durga Puram, Satyanarayana Puram, Kedareswarpet, Chittinagar, Bhavani Puram, Gollapudi. and 14 buses are running from other places like Tiruvuru, Nuzivid, Visannapeta, Madhira, Nandigama and Gannavaram. There are 3 College Buses exclusively for transporting the girl students from the Hostel which is situated in the town centre.
